To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) the intentional structure of dialogue is an important aspect to consider for modelling coherence and (2) our models outperform state-of-the-art baselines in coherence modelling for dialogue.

(1) the intentional grid representation outperforms the original entity grid in dialogue coherence modelling; (2) the intentional grid is able to learn a more fine-grained representation of coherence; (3) our model outperforms state-of-the-art baselines for both text discrimination and text insertion tasks.

(1) we propose a new model for coherence assessment of dialogue based on an extension of the original grid model that incorporates intents; (2) we evaluate our approach on three different datasets and show that it outperforms state-of-the-art models for coherence assessment of text.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following question: How to augment the original entity grid document representation for coherence assessment to include dialogue structure?
the problem of assessing coherence in dialogue, a problem that has been widely ignored in the literature.
the following questions: How can the intentional structure of dialogue be modelled? How can this structure be exploited to assess dialogue coherence?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our models, which combine the entity grid with intents, outperform the original entity grid on both text discrimination (F1 score of 0.73 vs 0.69) and insertion (F1 score 0.72 vs 0.68) tasks.
our model, which is the first to incorporate the intentional structure of dialogue, outperforms all previous models on all three tasks.
the coherence of a dialogue is not only the coherence of its sentences and the coherence of its turns, but also the coherence of its intents.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we show how the intentional structure of a dialogue is a key component to model dialogue coherence, and that this can be done by augmenting a standard grid document representation with the intentional structure.
intents are crucial for dialogue coherence modelling, and that our models outperform the state of the art on the two most important tasks for coherence modelling.
the entity grid is a powerful tool to model dialogue coherence, and that the intentional structure of a dialogue is a key factor to consider when modelling dialogue coherence.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the intentional structure of dialogue is an important factor for coherence modelling.
the original entity grid representation can be successfully extended to dialogue by adding the intentional structure of conversations.
dialogue models should be built upon the intentional structure of conversations, and that this can be achieved by augmenting existing models with a representation of the dialogue intents.
